presets.name: subtle_push_in
presets.prompt_phrase: camera slowly pushes in {amount} over the shot, ease-in-out

presets.name: snap_push
presets.prompt_phrase: camera snaps in quickly then holds, quart ease-out

presets.name: slow_orbit
presets.prompt_phrase: camera slowly orbits {amount} around the object, ease-circ

presets.name: crane_reveal
presets.prompt_phrase: camera cranes {direction} while pushing in slightly, revealing {detail}

presets.name: parallax_drift
presets.amount: 1-3% background, matched to camera speed foreground
presets.prompt_phrase: gentle parallax drift between background and foreground layers as the camera moves

presets.name: micro_drift_static
presets.prompt_phrase: camera holds steady with only micro-drift, no shake

presets.name: whip_pan
presets.prompt_phrase: camera whip-pans {direction}, motion blur, resolving into focus on the next subject

presets.name: object_orbit_rotation
presets.move: camera orbit synced to object rotation
presets.prompt_phrase: camera orbits in sync with the object's rotation, adding dimensionality
